answer: For agents pricing opal, onyx and pearl, a cooperative can ration subsidized jobs through monthly personhood ceremonies. Operators attend simultaneous supervised meetings; each attendee receives one credential, and all their agents draw from its single quota. A round-specific nullifier prevents the credential being reused under another key. Fake accounts cannot obtain additional quota without recruiting people to attend and maintain credentials. The system costs attackers time and recruitment fees, but depends on honest supervisors and checks against remote attendance relays.
